decisions.M2: The report permits documenting the server limit. prior_consent remains a client pre-grant; PHP blocking is deliberately stricter under an opt-in law. REST description and README state this limit.
decisions.L10: Done in 1.34.2 after all: created_at stays site time for compatibility; created_at_gmt stores the UTC instant on every insert and is backfilled by an idempotent, batched migration using the site's current time zone (the only information an old row carries). Readers fall back to the computed value only for rows without one.
decisions.G3: FAZ does not generate GPP. The shipped rule sets no longer declare it; the schema accepts signals.gpp as a deprecated, ignored property so custom rule sets written for 1.34.1 keep validating. External CMP strings are captured using ping, bounded by a timeout and a pagehide flush, and stored only when shaped like a GPP string.

integration_regressions: Namespaced compact vendor and Right-to-Object records survive A → B → A.
The PHP geo comparator uses the multisite fingerprint and the namespaced DNSMPI signal.
PMP necessary-only exemption cannot authorize an optional grant from another scope.
Decision/ID snapshot, fresh TC string, passive GPP, unload flush and stale-token recovery coexist in the logger.
Forged parking attributes cannot exempt a live iframe src.
A JSON assignment to location is evaluated as code.

Without geo routing a recorded scope is invalidated only by a change of law (slug, fingerprint and AUTH-salt changes do not re-prompt); with geo routing banner, law and fingerprint all decide. On cached pages GCM restores the stored choice once the live scope resolves. PHP, runtime, GCM and TCF regressions were observed failing before this correction.
not_in_scope: The 5 refuted findings in section 3 require no corrective change.
Headless content.rendered and translation-provider language resolution were explicitly unverified in the source report and are not included in the 56 entries.
